# TROUBLEBABA — Bento Cake

> A digital PDF cookbook with 10 author recipes for bento-cakes by Ukrainian pastry chef Yevgeniya (@troublebaba). Instant download in Ukrainian, Russian, English or Polish. One-time purchase, 800 UAH (~$20). Sold worldwide by Lemon Squeezy (merchant of record).

The author is Yevgeniya Golitsyna, based in Poland, a professional pastry chef with 2M+ followers across TikTok / Instagram / YouTube who has been publishing recipes and running cake workshops since 2014. This PDF is her signature bento-cake collection with exact gram-level measurements, ingredient conversion tables for any pan size, packaging & serving guides, and step-by-step photos.
